Thane West
Notice period: 30 days

Professional Summary
Backend-focused engineer with strong experience building and operating Go services, RPC APIs and relational data stores. Proven track record designing gRPC interfaces, optimizing PostgreSQL schemas and implementing reliable CI/CD workflows to support high-throughput production systems.

Technical Skills
Go, gRPC, postgresql, Confluence, Jira, Git

Work Experience

Senior Go Developer, Quanta Retail (Jan 2024 - Present)
- Implemented gRPC-based catalog and pricing services in Go, reducing API latency by 28% and enabling 1500+ requests/sec per instance while using PostgreSQL for transactional durability.
- Led schema redesign in PostgreSQL to support multi-tenant product catalogs, cutting query times for common lookups by 40% and improving index utilization.
- Established Git-driven feature branches and Confluence-run runbooks for service ownership; used Jira to track releases and incident postmortems.

Platform Engineer, Zoho (Feb 2023 - Dec 2023)
- Built Go microservices exposing gRPC endpoints to internal clients, improving inter-service throughput and reducing coupling for the notification platform.
- Migrated core metadata storage to a normalized PostgreSQL schema with rollup tables, improving reporting query performance by 35%.
- Automated deployment pipelines with Git-based CI and documented platform standards in Confluence; coordinated sprints and incident tracking via Jira.

Go Developer, Zentrix Labs (Nov 2018 - Jan 2023)
- Developed high-concurrency Go services communicating over gRPC for real-time analytics ingestion, scaling to handle bursts of 10k events/sec while persisting to PostgreSQL.
- Designed partitioning and indexing strategies in PostgreSQL to support time-series workloads and reduced storage costs through efficient retention policies.
- Maintained codebase and pull request workflows using Git, and authored design notes and runbooks in Confluence; tracked feature development and bugs in Jira.

Backend Engineer, NimbusSoft (Jun 2017 - Oct 2018)
- Implemented backend APIs in Go for order processing with PostgreSQL as the primary datastore, improving end-to-end processing throughput by 22%.
- Created gRPC client libraries for downstream services to standardize communication and reduce integration time across teams.
- Managed source control with Git and documented system behavior in Confluence; used Jira for sprint planning and issue tracking.

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
